headline: Inside a herring spawning run, filmed at forty metres
standfirst: Three nights on the seabed with a low-light rig, waiting for a shoal that arrives without warning and leaves before dawn.

body.text: Herring spawn on gravel, at night, in numbers that make the seabed disappear. Our camera team spent three nights waiting on a known ground off the Antrim coast for a run that has become steadily less predictable.
